_comment: THE HARDWIRED ACTION INVENTORY. A request names an id from this file and
nothing else - no command, no path, no arguments. That is the whole safety
property: there is no request field that can reach a shell, so there is
nothing to inject into. Adding a capability means editing this file and
shipping it, which is a review, not a runtime decision.
'requires' gates against the listener's mode: prompt < tool < agent.
'prompt' is what the ? lightbox shows and what Prompt Only hands back. It
must describe the SAME work 'run' performs, because a user who inspects the
prompt and then presses the button is trusting that they match.
Placeholders in args are resolved by the LISTENER from its own startup
configuration - never from the request. Known: {sheet} {gameRoot} {records}
